source_variable_reconciliation.source_Seed_set: Original Data sheet column V, ratio from collected fruit
source_variable_reconciliation.source_Seed_weights: Original column W; source metadata says Seed.count + Small.seed + Ovule
source_variable_reconciliation.paper_seedset_formula: Published Methods state developed seeds / (developed seeds + unfertilized ovules)
source_variable_reconciliation.note: Use the pre-registered original Seed.set values, do not relabel as paper-arithmetic-equivalent or replace the response after observing result. Different denominator for 10 original fruits may reflect inclusion of immature seeds; author processing cannot be inferred.

protocol_model.M0: film Julian day, 2 train-median-imputed log floral neighborhood counts + 2 missing flags, log1p visitation count / film hour for each of 4 legitimate bee/fly groups
protocol_model.non_intercept: train-only mean/SD z-transform and ridge L2
protocol_model.decision: pooled MSE gain >=5% AND 6/8 positive filming date folds

independent_numeric_check.method1: artifact_tool XLSX import and NumPy ridge normal equations
independent_numeric_check.method2: separate stdlib OOXML and Gaussian elimination
independent_numeric_check.comparison: 8 days x 2 models x (MSE and MAE) = 32 aggregate scores

scientific_scope: Original Smith, Swartz & Spigler (2021) already discovered that CP load modifies heterospecific-pollen seed-set cost.
This is original-source within-study temporal transport, not an independent landscape, species or external validation.
29/122 missing mature fruits due to loss/herbivory, not source biological zero and not confirmed missing at random.
Five of 93 modeled flowers lack floral-neighborhood covariates and are imputed only using training-date medians, incl four from day196.
Four of eight complete-date test groups are positive, two n4 days with much less reliable date-group estimates; do not cherry-pick.
Stigma pollen quantity/composition is not genetically compatible pollen receipt, confirmed paternity or recruited offspring.
Original source seed-set denominator differs from literal published formula for ten flowers.
No causal effect of flower visitors or new universal functional-fragmentation regime established.
No third-party raw Excel, pollen/seed individual rows or identifying sample data committed.
